name: Prudent Corporate Advisory Services Ltd
title: Prudent Corporate Advisory Services Ltd - 543527 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Prudent's MF-distribution AUM hit a record 1.33 trn by May 5 (9.7% above FY26 average) and equity net sales hit a record INR 4,300 cr, but yield and payout changes from SEBI TER rules add uncertainty.

triggers.label: Equity net sales record INR 4,300 cr
triggers.quote: we recorded our highest-ever equity net sales in a single quarter of INR 4,300 crore
triggers.highlight: highest-ever equity net sales in a single quarter

triggers.label: Yield held at 91 bps for 3 years
triggers.quote: our yield has remained more or less stable at 91 basis point, not only for the year, but for last three years in a row

triggers.label: Non-GST MFDs lose 15-20% revenue
triggers.quote: For the non-GST partner, I think across the board, there is an impact of 15%-20% of the revenue

triggers.label: Back-book repricing 2-3 bps
triggers.quote: we assume that as far as book is concerned, there might be impact of 2 to 3 basis points on the entire AUM

triggers.label: Q4 AUM down 8.2% equity QoQ on MTM
triggers.quote: Equity AUM declined by 8.2% during the quarter

guidance.metric: Employee cost growth for existing base FY27
guidance.quote: we expect that the employee cost for the existing base will increase by approximately 14% in FY '27
my gross sales has to be in the range of INR 30-35,000 crore on a total AUM of INR 1,30,000 crore
next year it could be INR 8.5 crore. It is a year, and I have not gone to the board. It is a ballpark number.

guidance.value: very healthy income by 30 June if markets stay
guidance.quote: by 30th June we expect a very healthy income from other income side

red_flags.label: Life insurance renewal growth slowing
red_flags.quote: by my calculation, the renewal growth rate has come off

red_flags.label: Management deflects persistency and SIP cancellation questions
red_flags.quote: Chirag, can you take this question up? Chirag, are you there?

evasions.quote: So, to give you an indication that what is likely to be the blended yield, it would be very, very difficult.
Chirag, can you take this question up? Chirag, are you there?
But still, a couple of AMCs are yet to communicate clearly.
